# orbivisor_backup_store (Resource)

A backup store (directory or S3). Give secrets with the write-only attributes.

Manifest kind `BackupStore`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (Dynamic) Backend (`{ kind = "dir", path = … }` or S3).
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `encryption` (Dynamic) Encryption (the key goes in `encryption_key_wo`).
- `encryption_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Encryption master key (base64; write-only). Only used when the store is created. Needs Terraform 1.11+ (tested with OpenTofu 1.13).
- `encryption_key_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `encryption_key_wo` again (the value itself is not stored, so Terraform cannot see it change).
- `gc` (Dynamic)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `max_streams` (Number)
- `read_only` (Boolean)
- `s3_secret_access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) S3 secret access key (write-only). Sent on create and when `s3_secret_access_key_wo_version` changes. Needs Terraform 1.11+ (tested with OpenTofu 1.13).
- `s3_secret_access_key_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `s3_secret_access_key_wo` again (the value itself is not stored, so Terraform cannot see it change).
- `verify` (Dynamic)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
